title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
  
  
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
* Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
* Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
* Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
* Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
* Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
* Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
* Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
* Strong C programming and debugging skills.
* Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
* Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
* Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd**

* Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
* Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
* Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
* Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
* Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

description:
**Overview**
Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.
  
  
We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.
  
  
We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.
  
  
Bring your whole self.
  
  
The Role and Team
  
  
At Medallia, our Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across our platform.
  
  
Our systems sit at the core that support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.
  
  
As our platform continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale.
  
  
You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across the platform.
  
  
This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions — Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e.g., which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision — not just have an opinion on them.
* Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams — multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships.
* Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against — e.g., how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views. Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives — examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth.
* Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes — e.g., assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively.
* Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against.
* Get hands-on when it matters — staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out.
* Improve how the platform is operated at scale — reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions — driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary.
* Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e.g., Java and TypeScript/Node.js, or equivalent) — this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams).
* Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes.
* Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness — tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers.
* A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing — RFCs, design docs, or equivalent — and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
  

* Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code.
* Experience with identity resolution systems — matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale.
* Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination.
* Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort — e.g., bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration.
* Background in customer experience management, survey platforms, or voice-of-customer systems.
* Experience as a technical lead on a greenfield platform build, with scars to show for the early architectural bets that worked and the ones that didn't.

description:

**Title And Summary**
Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering’ for Operational Intelligence Program, within B&MI group. This role will lead ML engineering team to execute on AI/ML strategy for the program that enables business growth, enhances customer experience, and ensures delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing software solutions. As a technology leader, this role will also focus on engineering best practices, next gen innovation and stakeholder management, while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within the team.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Implement multi-agent intelligence frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) to enable reasoning, coordination, and adaptive decision-making across specialized AI agents.
* Design and operationalize multi-modal AI pipelines combining text, image, tabular, and graph data using transformer-based architectures (BERT, CLIP, LLaVA, T5, Whisper, etc.) for unified intelligence.
* Build scalable RAG and Graph-RAG systems integrating vector stores and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to enable contextual retrieval, semantic linking, and entity-aware reasoning.
* Develop and productionize transformer-based models for NLP, vision-language understanding, and sequential prediction tasks leveraging Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow ecosystems.
* Implement advanced Python-based backend services for inference orchestration, async job handling, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput AI operations.
* Establish end-to-end LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) integrating MLflow, feature stores, model lineage, prompt evaluation, and continuous retraining frameworks.
* Apply traditional AI/ML and statistical modeling techniques (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) alongside deep learning models for hybrid interpretability and explainability.
* Engineer state and memory management subsystems that preserve context, track embeddings, and enable agents to reason temporally across multiple modalities and interactions.
* Implement Responsible AI practices—bias detection, explainability dashboards, data ethics checks, and performance governance ensuring fairness and transparency of deployed models.
* Continuously research, benchmark, and productionize innovations in multimodal transformers, generative modeling, and agentic orchestration to drive enterprise-scale intelligence and automation.

**All About You**

* Master’s/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering, and a considerable work experience with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex projects/products and delivering to aggressive market needs.
* Expert-level hands on experience designing, building and deploying both conventional AI/ML solutions and LLM/Agentic solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Experience with AI and machine learning platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python/SQL is a must. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of cloud computing services (AWS, Azure, GCP) related to data processing and storage is a plus.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Description**
The Position
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Engineering Manager to lead a team of Fullstack Engineers responsible for building and maintaining scalable, high-performance applications and platforms that serve both internal teams and external partners.
  
  
As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers while driving the successful delivery of enterprise-grade SaaS products and platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, Designers, and Engineering leaders to execute against product roadmaps, improve engineering effectiveness, and ensure high-quality software delivery.
  
  
This role requires a strong technical foundation in Python, React, cloud-native technologies, and modern software architecture principles. You will provide technical leadership, facilitate technical discussions, guide engineering decisions, and help teams build scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in balancing business priorities, customer needs, technical investments, and team development. Success in this role requires strong people leadership, operational excellence, strategic thinking, and the ability to build and grow high-performing engineering teams.
  
  
You will independently own team execution, delivery outcomes, engineering excellence, and employee development while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**We Expect Our Team Members To**

* Act with integrity, even when it’s hard
* Always stay curious and ready to learn
* Work to meaningful outcomes, mindful of each step
* Operate as a unified team, made stronger by uniqueness

**Responsibilities & Skills**
You should:
  
  

* Be excited to work with talented, committed people in a fast-paced environment.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of 5+ software engineers across multiple experience levels.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, inclusivity, and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, career development guidance, and growth opportunities for team members.
* Drive engineering execution across multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring alignment with business goals and product priorities.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, Designers, and stakeholders to define scope, priorities, delivery plans, and technical strategy.
* Support project planning, resource allocation, estimation, and prioritization to maximize business impact.
* Balance customer commitments, operational support needs, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and new feature development.
* Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, security, observability, and operational best practices.
* Ensure timely delivery of high-quality software with strong attention to scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and security.
* Promote Agile development practices and continuously improve team processes and delivery effectiveness.
* Identify risks early, remove blockers, and proactively mitigate challenges impacting delivery or team productivity.
* Keep teams aligned with long-term product and platform strategy while effectively managing near-term commitments.
* Understand business objectives and ensure engineering decisions support company goals and customer outcomes.
* Lead by example through technical credibility, sound judgment, and a solutions-oriented mindset.
* Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Be exceptionally self-motivated, proactive, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment.

**Required Skills (Frontend – React & Angular)**

* Have 12+ years of industry experience delivering enterprise-grade software products, including 3–5 years in an engineering leadership role.
* Have experience building or scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, APIs, and customer-facing applications using Python and React.
* Possess strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable microservices-based systems.
* Have experience coding with Python and modern frontend frameworks such as React and/or Angular.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, security principles, reliability, and cost optimization.
* Have hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms and core cloud services.
* Understand CI/CD practices, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps principles.
* Have experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Be familiar with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Be proficient with Jira, Confluence, and modern engineering collaboration tools.

**Required**
The following experiences are not required, but you'll stand out from other applicants if you have any of the following, in our order of importance:
  
  

* Experience with Databricks, Data Lakes, BigQuery, or modern data platform technologies.
* Experience working in a SaaS or product-led software organization.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and serverless technologies.
* Experience building reusable platform services, frameworks, or shared engineering capabilities.
* Experience contributing to engineering strategy, organizational planning, and budgeting.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.
* Experience working in the Utility, Energy, or Sustainability domain.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Intern - Data Analyst
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Data Analyst Intern
  
  
**Location:**
Pune (on-site)
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
12:00 PM – 8:30 PM IST
  
  
**Duration:**
6 months
  
  
**About Amber**
Amber is a long-term accommodation booking platform for students (think booking.com for student housing). We help 80M+ students globally find and book full-time accommodation near their universities, without the hassle of negotiations, non-standardized paperwork, or broken payment processes.
  
  
We are the largest and fastest-growing student housing platform globally, with 1M+ units across 6 countries and 100+ cities, backed by $21M in institutional funding led by Gaja Capital.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As an AI Data Analyst Intern, you’ll work on real analytical projects for our business, operations, and product teams, using AI tools as a core part of how you work. We want someone who uses AI to move faster and still checks every number before it reaches a stakeholder.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own project-specific analyses for business, operations, or product teams.
* Write, debug, and optimize SQL queries, using AI assistants to speed up the work and validating every result yourself.
* Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau / Power BI to track key metrics and trends.
* Use AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to explore data, automate repetitive reporting, and prototype small tools.
* Find patterns, gaps, and opportunities in the data, and turn them into clear recommendations.
* Present insights to stakeholders in a clear, structured way.
* Document prompts, workflows, and automations so the team can reuse them.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions).
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups) and Tableau and/or Power BI.
* Regular, hands-on use of AI chatbots for real work, not just casual use.
* Basic experience with at least one AI coding tool or agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar).
* Have built something of your own using AI: an app, a script, a dashboard, an automation, or an analysis. Shipped, rough, or half-broken all count. We want to see that you built it.

* Able to work independently on defined projects and meet timelines.

* Familiarity with APIs, MCP, or connecting AI tools to data sources.

Send your resume along with:

*Applications without a project link will not be considered.*
**Why Join Amber?**

* Work on real business problems at a global, high-growth startup.
* Live projects, not mock assignments.
* AI-first workflows: you’ll use and help shape how our analytics team works with AI.
* Learn hands-on from experienced analysts and business leaders.
* Fast-paced, collaborative, learning-focused culture.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**Blessing Softtech (Fonazo) | Pune, Maharashtra | Full-time | On-site**

Blessing Softtech is hiring a
**FinOps Engineer**
to run the financial operations behind Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.

You will own the money path end to end for every Fonazo client: subscription billing, payment gateways, reconciliation, collections, refunds and revenue reporting. Every invoice billed correctly, every payment collected on time, every settlement accounted for.

**Experience:**
4+ years

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting or a related field

**Location:**
Pune, work from office

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

Key Responsibilities

**Subscription Billing and Revenue**

* Run end-to-end subscription billing for Fonazo clients, including recurring payments, plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations and plan changes.
* Track MRR, ARR, customer lifetime value, churn and subscription growth.
* Ensure correct calculation of prorated billing, discounts, promotional offers, taxes and fees.
* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, find the root cause and fix it.

**Payment Gateways**

* Manage operations across gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com and similar providers.
* Configure and monitor gateway settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods and recurring billing.
* Track success rates, declined transactions, gateway fees, refunds and settlement discrepancies by provider.
* Work with engineering on integration issues, API billing errors, webhook failures and transaction status mismatches.
* Evaluate gateways on pricing, supported currencies, geographic coverage and settlement timelines.

**Reconciliation and Settlement**

* Reconcile gateway transactions, invoices, customer payments, refunds and bank settlements daily, weekly and monthly.
* Verify gross transaction values, processing fees, taxes, net settlements and disputed transactions.
* Resolve discrepancies between gateways, internal billing, accounting records and bank statements.
* Monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions and payment reversals.
* Maintain ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports and audit-ready documentation.

**Client Financial Operations**

* Own billing, collections and account-level financial records for multiple Fonazo clients.
* Prepare client-wise statements covering revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges and net settlements.
* Resolve client billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies and refund requests.
* Communicate clearly and on time with clients about failed payments, pending dues and billing changes.

**Refunds, Chargebacks and Disputes**

* Manage refunds, chargebacks, reversals and disputed transactions within company and gateway policy.
* Collect evidence and work with payment providers to close disputes on time.
* Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends and fraud indicators.
* Set procedures for refund approvals, transaction verification and dispute escalation.

**Reporting, MIS and Analytics**

* Produce daily, weekly and monthly MIS on subscription revenue, collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds and settlements.
* Build dashboards for MRR, ARR, churn, renewal rate, payment success rate, outstanding receivables and revenue leakage.
* Analyse gateway fees, client profitability, transaction costs and contribution margins.
* Automate reporting with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools.

**Financial Controls and Compliance**

* Set internal controls for billing, refunds, settlements, revenue recognition and financial adjustments.
* Maintain audit trails, approval workflows and supporting documents for reviews and audits.
* Support PCI DSS, tax, data protection and payment provider requirements across relevant markets.
* Monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorised refunds and fraud indicators.

**Product and Engineering Coordination**

* Translate financial requirements into specifications for plans, billing logic, invoices, retries, refunds and settlement workflows.
* Validate gateway integrations, subscription lifecycle events and billing calculations at each release.
* Test payment APIs, webhook events, recurring billing, failed-payment recovery and refund workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities that reduce manual reconciliation and scale with client volume.

**Payment Optimisation and Planning**

* Analyse failed and declined transactions and address their causes.
* Run dunning, automated retries, renewal reminders and failed-payment recovery.
* Reduce involuntary churn and processing costs.
* Support revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, collection projections and month-end close.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing and revenue reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience with one or more payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Square, Payoneer or Amazon Pay.
* Experience with subscription lifecycle management, invoicing, payment retries, refunds, chargebacks and settlement reconciliation.
* Knowledge of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, gateway fees and cash flow management.
* Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup functions and financial reporting.
* Experience building dashboards and MIS reports in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL and financial data analysis is preferred.
* Understanding of payment gateway APIs, webhooks and transaction statuses is an advantage.
* Familiarity with accounting or ERP systems and automated billing platforms is preferred.
* International payments, multi-currency transactions, cross-border settlements and tax treatment are an advantage.

Experience and Education

* 4+ years in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations.
* Hands-on experience with payment gateways and recurring subscription payment systems.
* Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients, accounts or subscription products.
* SaaS, AI products, voice agent platforms or other recurring-revenue business experience is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration or a related discipline is required.
* Master's degree or relevant certifications are preferred or advantageous.

How You Will Be Measured

* Accuracy and timeliness of subscription billing and reconciliation.
* Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies and unaccounted transactions.
* Payment success rate and failed-payment recovery.
* Speed of collections, refund processing and dispute resolution.
* Accurate, on-time MIS reports and dashboards.
* Lower gateway costs and less preventable revenue leakage.
* Effectiveness of billing automation and process improvements.
* Compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.

Why Join Fonazo?

* Work on the financial operations of an AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.
* Own end-to-end billing, payments, reconciliation and revenue operations.
* Collaborate with finance, product, engineering and customer support teams.
* Help build scalable financial processes for a growing multi-client platform.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their
**CV / Resume**
to hr@blessingsofttech.com, along with a short note describing the hardest reconciliation problem they have solved.

Please include:

* Transaction volume handled.
* Payment gateways involved.
* What was breaking or causing the reconciliation issue.
* How you identified the root cause and fixed it.

**Experience:**
4+ years

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

**Company:**
Blessing Softtech (Fonazo)

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**About Mindstix Software Labs**

Mindstix accelerates digital transformation for the world's leading brands. We are a team of passionate innovators specialized in Product Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Data Science and Digital Experiences.

Our UX studio and modern-stack engineers deliver world-class products for our global customers, including Fortune 500 enterprises and Silicon Valley startups. Our work impacts a diverse set of industries such as eCommerce, Luxury Retail, SaaS, Consumer Tech, Health Tech, and Hospitality.

A fast-moving open culture powered by curiosity and craftsmanship. A team committed to bold thinking and innovation at the very intersection of business, technology, and design. That’s our DNA.

Mindstix is looking for Salesforce developers. As a member of the Salesforce team, you will have an opportunity to work on leading-edge CRM platforms like Salesforce and Commerce Cloud.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

Mindstix is looking for a passionate and experienced
**Senior Salesforce Engineer**
to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience in Salesforce development within complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of scalable application architecture and platform best practices.

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust Salesforce solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality applications.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Build and optimize Apex triggers, controllers, batch processes, and asynchronous processing solutions.
* Develop reusable and maintainable Lightning Web Components with clear component hierarchies and event-driven communication patterns.
* Design and implement automation strategies using Flows and Apex while ensuring scalability and maintainability.
* Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks and governor limit issues in high-volume Salesforce environments.
* Design and implement integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Work closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and promote engineering best practices across the team.
* Implement secure and scalable solutions while adhering to Salesforce security best practices, including OWD, Sharing Rules, and Field-Level Security.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams and manage deployments using Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues while ensuring system reliability and performance.
* Continuously evaluate and improve existing Salesforce implementations and automation strategies.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of
  **7+ years**
  of hands-on experience in Salesforce development, with significant experience in enterprise Salesforce environments.
* Strong expertise in:
* Apex Development (Triggers, Controllers, Batch Apex, Asynchronous Processing)
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Salesforce Flows and Automation Architecture
* Salesforce Platform Events and Bulk API
* Salesforce Security Model
* REST/SOAP Integrations and Named Credentials
* Strong understanding of Salesforce order of execution, recursion handling, and scalable automation design patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Git, including branching, merging, conflict resolution, and pull request workflows.
* Experience with deployment tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Sourcetree is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Scratch Orgs, Connected Apps, and OAuth is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test data setup, and code quality practices.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Who Fits Best?**

* You have worked in complex enterprise Salesforce environments and have successfully improved existing systems and processes.
* You take ownership of technical decisions and proactively address scalability and maintainability concerns.
* You are passionate about writing clean, reusable, and high-quality code.
* You enjoy mentoring team members and contributing to engineering excellence.
* You are a self-motivated, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative environment.
* You possess strong verbal and written communication skills and can effectively work with global teams and stakeholders.

**Benefits**

An opportunity to work in a competitive environment with top-tier engineers in your industry. Flexible working environment, competitive compensation and perks, health insurance coverage, rewards and recognition, accelerated career planning. An opportunity to build products and solutions at a truly global scale.

**Location**

This position is primarily based at our Pune (India) headquarters, requiring all potential hires to work from this location. A modern workplace is deeply collaborative by nature, while also demanding a touch of flexibility. We embrace deep collaboration at our offices with reasonable flexi-timing and hybrid options to our seasoned team members.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Mindstix is committed to an inclusive and diverse work environment. We do
*not*
discriminate based on race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any other legally protected status.

A

provides technical leadership for

, owns UI architecture decisions, and ensures delivery excellence across projects. The role includes mentoring consultants, influencing design decisions, and driving front end best practices.

* Lead complex UI implementations and performance optimization initiatives.
* Oversee API integration from a front end contract and usability perspective.
* Review and approve code to ensure quality, security, and scalability.
* Mentor and guide Consultants and junior developers.
* Collaborate with architects, backend leads, and product stakeholders.
* Drive UI performance monitoring and diagnostics using Azure App Insights.
* Support release readiness, production issues, and corrective actions.

* Communicates effectively with stakeholders and leadership.
